description: Narrow shafts of light strike through the thick canopy, doing little to break the unnatural darkness of the woods. description: A thick, clammy haze oozes out of the surrounding weeds to choke the road and reduce vision to merely a few feet.  The moon is a wide orb with blurry edges hanging somewhere far above the mist, adding no heat to help assuage the dank chill.  If not for the few cobblestones still visible above the mud, the correct direction of travel would be anyone's guess.

A thick, steamy haze oozes out of the surrounding weeds to choke the road and reduce vision to merely a few feet.  The sun is a wide orb with blurry edges hanging somewhere far above the mist, adding more heat to the trapped humidity.  If not for the few cobblestones still visible above the mud, the correct direction of travel would be anyone's guess.
title: [Gyldemar Road]
10820.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Wet blackness envelops everything, and the mud grasps powerfully at feet and legs.  The lack of vision and the unsure footing in the muck below combine to confuse the senses, making direction a meaningless idea.  Even "up" is in question at times.  One can only swim and hope.
title: [Under The Black Water]
10821.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The bog has almost totally reclaimed the road.  Rushes spring up where once a flat, well-maintained road might have run.  Only here and there do cobblestones still make a wary appearance, fighting to stay on top of the cloying sludge.  So very few of them remain, though, that it often takes careful searching to find the next cobblestone and thus continue in the right direction.  Growls and snarls out in the thicker rushes suggest that there are those that wish the stones could not be found.
title: [Gyldemar Road]
10832.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Thick rushes rise from the dank water, choking the area and providing excellent cover for anything small enough to fit underneath them.  The rushes, combined with the water cover and unsure footing, keep the larger predators out of the area.  Muskrat dens appear frequently along the edges of what might still be called a 'road,' and often one of the small, bare-tailed mammals can be seen scurrying for the safety of its home.
title: [Gyldemar Road]
10833.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Something has died just off the road.  It is far enough out in the swamp that moving off the road to investigate would be foolhardy at best, but close enough that the flies and odor are very much apparent.  This, combined with the oppressive humidity, mist, sucking mud and monotonous vegetation suggest that there are probably far more interesting places one could occupy.  The road, as best as can be ascertained, continues to forge northwest and east.
title: [Gyldemar Road]
10834.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Spartan enough to make a Vaalor elf proud, the interior of the office is empty but for a single cot, a collapsible field desk, and a chest opened to reveal numerous pigeon holes filled with scrolls, maps, and other papers.  A banner hangs on one wall, opposite two large windows made of double arches and set with a wide wooden sill.
title: [Outpost, Office]
13139.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The taskmaster stands before a wide map and is the center of a maelstrom of arriving and departing scouts and fellow members of the Guardians of Sunfist.  Two large windows formed from double arches are set into one wall of the room, while several shelves lining the walls opposite are covered in both spent and new candles.  A massive axe is leaned on its head in one corner, ready at a moment's notice for use by its owner.
title: [Outpost, Taskmaster's Post]
13140.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A large underground lake spreads onward into darkness, its tranquil waters undulating softly with every tiny ripple that seeks to disturb the solace.  Pale white sand borders the edges of the water, providing a welcome respite from the rocky ground of the area.  A variety of glowing fungi has colonized the blackness of the high ceiling in small patches -- casting the illusion of being underneath a sheer alien sky.
title: [Sorcerer Guild, Sitting Room]
18135.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Cavernous, high walls surround you, arcing upwards into darkness.  Lurid crimson torchlight ripples across the slightly damp stone walls, casting a dark scarlet sheen across the surroundings.  Several well-polished tunnels lead away from the central chamber, and dark velvet rugs flanked by intricate iron candelabras trail in their wake.  A complex, circular design of sigils loop and arc across the center of the room, their intricacy rather weathered by the passage of time.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west, up
title: [Sorcerer Guild, Chamber]
18150.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Incarnadine sigils wrap around the circular chamber in a tight embrace, their luminescent surfaces casting a bloody light throughout the surroundings as they hum and pulse with power.  A triple-band of the angular sigils forms a tight circle in the middle of the floor, the designs there casting a steady pale violet glow as the rest of the room is intermittently cast in darkness by the wavering symbols around you.

18151.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The tunnel ends abruptly here, and the polished appearance of the surrounding rock takes on an even deeper luster in the brighter light. Blackness shrouds the upper regions of the room in a murky haze.  Only brief glimpses of the ceiling are caught when the flames flare strongly.
title: [Sorcerer Guild, Chamber]
18152.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

A dark orb sits atop a pedestal of black onyx, its slick surface mere inches from the central crystal spoke jutting from the ceiling.  Slivers of incarnadine shot with violet tracing arc through the rift between the two, sending whirring hums of power echoing about you.

18153.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

18155.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A dark triple-horned skull hangs over the door, its fanged maw gleaming with reflected light from the numerous candles placed throughout the room. 18156.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The chambers open up into a vast, yawning expanse, and the dark waters of an underground lake spread onward into the darkness. A small upraised path winds its way through the lake, the faint torchlight that flanks it appearing as fireflies in the deep blackness.

18157.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Rings of lurid scarlet torchlight illuminate the surroundings in stark detail -- flanking the rocky path are a variety of large bones, seemingly melded into one another to form a grisly, spiked caricature of a twisted spine.  The skeletal remains appear to be animal at the beginning of the path, though the ones further along have a distinctly humanoid appearance.  Far ahead, a circle of blue flames casts a ghostly light upon a small island further to the south.

18158.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Ringed by a variety of splintered bone shards, a circular ivory building covers the entirety of the small island -- its surface slick and gleaming with the ghostly blue light of the surrounding torches. A vague rhythmic hum ripples outward from the building, its presence more felt than heard.

18159.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A large ebon coffin sits atop an altar of yellowed bone, its slick surface awash in the light of hundreds and hundreds of thin pillar candles that surround it on every side. 18160.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A variety of candles are placed upon an ancient reading desk, its surface marred with ink, stubs of wax, and ageless dust. description: Opaque mist forms the basis of this rotund chamber.  It has no physical walls nor any structure that lends it solid form.  Passageways created by the parting of mist open and close within a moment's notice at the beckoning of the Arcane Masters who buzz around the chamber at an almost frenzied pace attending to their tasks.  The world away from this room is completely obscured, and your existence is likely obscured from the world, with the exception of an opening in the mist directly in front of a rune-carved door.
title: [Sorcerer Guild, Arcane Studies]
19002.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A bower of trees looms high overhead, the verdant canopy contrasting sharply with the pale alabaster columns that reach up into their leafy depths. At one end of the court sits a large marble building, its wide porch and ornamental carvings standing out in stark relief from the lush backdrop.

19836.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Vaulted ceilings frame this wide gallery, set with skylights of polished glass. The foyer narrows on either side, bearing torch-lit hallways that lead further into the guild.
title: [Cleric Guild, Foyer]
19837.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: High vaulted windows line the walls of this large room, letting the light fall in muted tones on the sinuous contours of the teaching hall. A thin ornamentally carved podium sits atop the dais, situated so that is easily viewed from anywhere within the circular hall.
title: [Cleric Guild, Hall of Teaching]
19838.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Thick boughs of surrounding trees encroach upon this large garden, giving it an air of perpetual darkness despite the light that filters through the leaves. In the center, a series of square markers hewn from rough marble surround a painted bronze sculpture, each small block of stone incised with the symbol of a different Lornon Arkati.

19839.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A wide, mosaic-tiled pool of water holds court in the center of the garden, the gentle babbling from the fountain that rises from its center breaking up the reverent silence that permeates the clearing. Viridian leaves frame pale white moonflowers that edge the pool, mimicking the color of the plush, pristine white prayer mats that are carefully placed around the grounds.
title: [Cleric Guild, Liabo Garden]
19840.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This small garden is a study in contrasts, one side a blooming riot of color, the other an austerely pale space. Bordered by pale green ferns tipped with white, the other side of the garden bears the steady presence of Gosaena, her gaze impassive, as she surveys the clearing.  A tiled path cuts directly in between the two, leading to a column-flanked arch.
title: [Cleric Guild, Neutrality Garden]
19841.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Despite being smaller than the other gardens, this tiny clearing holds a reverence all its own. title: [Cleric Guild, Spirit Garden]
19842.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Brass fixtures line the walls, each bearing a dimly lit torch that illuminates the path down this narrow hall.  A wide square doorway is set in the center of one wall, its massive modwir doors protecting the space beyond.
title: [Cleric Guild, Northwest Hall]
19843.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Large arched windows cover the entire expanse of the far wall, shrouded in curtains of heavy linen, dimming the room. Either side of the room bears floor-to-ceiling bookshelves, each holding dusty tomes and well-worn scrolls.  Despite the guild members that study here, the library retains an air of reverent silence.
title: [Cleric Guild, Library]
19844.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A detailed fresco stretches the length of this hall, detailing a view of the Shining City.  Each carefully depicted locale is separated by a dimly lit torch set in a brass sconce. title: [Cleric Guild, Northeast Hall]
19845.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A pair of stained glass windows illuminates the small chamber with motes of soft color, paler tones of the peacock-crested banner that stretches in between them. Censers of polished bronze hang from tall stands at either side of the room, filling the small chamber with an earthy fragrance.
title: [Cleric Guild, Chambers]
19846.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Polished marble walls enclose this small room and gleam in the torchlight that filters in from either hallway.  The area is devoid of ornamentation, serving only as a passageway to other areas of the guild.
title: [Cleric Guild, Hallway]
19847.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A fountain flows into a large marble basin in the center of this airy courtyard, dimming the sounds of nearby training with its musical cascade. title: [Training Annex, Courtyard]

description: A steady hum resonates through the torch-lit avenue of columns, fed by the murmurs of students and masters as they talk along the open-air walk. 19849.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Small droplets of glowing, bright green liquid collect slowly along the cracks in the ceiling of the tunnel. The glowing stream then moves off to the south in a wide, iridescent, emerald ribbon.  Interestingly, nothing seems to grow or live in the water.
title: [Aqueduct]
11867.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The tunnel ends at a sheer granite wall.  A sparse amount of green light filters in from the south to barely illuminate the walls and floor in this dead-end. title: [Aqueduct]

description: A chill pervades the tunnel, rising damply from the slowly moving stream underfoot. The stream has made its choice, though, and it flows to the south.
title: [Aqueduct]
11869.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The short tunnel ends at a smooth granite wall.  A large pile of debris has mounded up against the wall, including pieces of petrified wood, bones, and other less recognizable items. title: [Aqueduct]
11870.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The soft emerald glow from the slowly moving stream barely illuminates the granite floor and the lower portions of the walls on either side of the tunnel. Noises echo, but in all directions at once, and they give no dependable indication of distances.  Only the sloshing green water and the pressing granite walls are apparent.
title: [Aqueduct]
11871.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The western wall has crumbled into the stream, creating a high, long pile of rubble that follows the western side of the tunnel. title: [Aqueduct]
11872.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The northwestern wall has partially collapsed, pushing a long mound of rubble onto the floor of the tunnel and forcing passage against the southeastern side. Shiny particles sparkle from some of the submerged rocks, indicating a possible source of mica may be nearby, but the volume apparent to the naked eye is not worth collecting.
title: [Aqueduct]
11873.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A steady stream pours down the slope from the east, and another stream of nearly the same volume joins from the northeast. Near the bottom of the slope, the constant action of pouring water has eroded a deep hole, but the rest of the area seems to be covered by a uniform two feet of water.
title: [Aqueduct]
11874.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The water rushes in from the east and is presented with a decision.  The tunnel forks.  One path leads northwest, and another leads southwest. 11875.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The water sits unmoving in this stretch of tunnel, its green glow muted by a layer of scum that has accumulated on the surface.  Apparently the water hasn't moved in a long time. 11876.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The air is dry and stale, hanging heavily above the slimy surface of the water.  The heavy layer of scum reduces the projected light to a diffuse glow, and most of the walls and ceiling are not visible.  The scum clings to armor, boots, clothing, and most anything else it can contact.  Breathing is laborious at best due to the lack of air circulation.
title: [Aqueduct]
11877.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The darkness closes in as the scum covering the water becomes heavier and heavier, compressed to the northwest by additions from the east.  On the north wall a skeleton hangs from a steel-like spike driven deep into the granite rock. title: [Aqueduct]
11878.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This forgotten arm of the tunnels ends at a cave-in that totally blocks passage of water or creature. Strange patches of light and shadow play off the walls as the scum layer is disturbed by the passage of wading adventurers.

11879.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A side tunnel basically extends nowhere here. The reason is lost in history, and the unmoving, emerald water provides no clue.  The eastern wall has crumbled away, though, to reveal a high breach. title: [Aqueduct]
11880.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The only illumination in the constricted, foreboding tunnel comes from the water that courses from the north and empties out to the southwest. The transparency, though, is tinged with an emerald glow, as if one is looking through green-colored lenses.  The glow is not at all powerful, and the illumination ends only a few feet up the wall, leaving the ceiling in total darkness.

11881.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Thousands, perhaps hundreds of thousands of gossamer webs spread across the upper walls and ceiling of this portion of the tunnel. In each web a tiny spider holds sway, crouching at the center and ferociously guarding its territory.  It is impossible to determine what these spiders feed on, though, as no flying or crawling insect-life is evident.
title: [Aqueduct]
11882.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A convergence of streams occurs, with a larger body of water rushing in from the southeast to collide with a smaller flow from the northeast. Likewise, the air following the streams whistles and howls as it is forced to accommodate an additional volume in a more constricted space.

11883.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The stream flows steadily east to west, hemmed in by the tunnel walls on either side.  A shaft of light pierces the gloom overhead to illuminate the rounded sides of an old well. title: [Aqueduct]

description: A foot or so above the stream's flow, small clumps of moss have taken hold on the granite sides of the tunnel. title: [Aqueduct]

The water rushes out of the constricted opening with a loud roar, spraying as if under pressure and plunging down to intermingle with the river's waters just below.  The water tugs at you insistently, beckoning you to become one with the river as it soon will.

description: The road here is wide, bounded to the east by the height of the city wall, and to the west by a series of shattered towers.  The ruins of several long low buildings form dark mounds beneath the slender silhouettes of the towers.
